mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Corporate Registry or Company Secretary in the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for the Colombian local legal representative and AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the foreign jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and senior officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government authority (Passport Office) or foreign notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Restrictive Measures, UIAF PEP and terrorist-financing lists, Colombian Consejo Nacional Electoral PEP registry, INTERPOL and domestic judicial investigation lists, with enhanced due diligence for any positive hits; continuous surveillance required once the corporate under-taking is established.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) via the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) web portal and the Ventanilla Única de Registro (VUE)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory name must be in Spanish or use Latin-script transliteration if foreign words are included; no non-Latin scripts accepted; the corporate suffix 'S.A.S.' must appear in the exact legal name; names must not be substantially identical to any existing registered trademark or trade name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a 'recurso de reposición' with the same Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days, and if denied, a 'recurso de apelación' must be filed before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within the next 5 business days. The administrative appeal must specify the name’s compliance with Circular Única of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio and include a revised proposed name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office for a dangerous goods freight forwarding company. A physical commercial address with operational archives, personnel, and document retention is mandatory under Decree 1717 de 2020 and sector regulations issued by the Superintendencia de Transporte. Virtual offices may only be utilized as auxiliary correspondence centers, never as the statutory registered seat.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas, Arts. 1-5, 17, 22); Código de Comercio Decreto 410 de 1971, Libro II; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (registro mercantil); Ley 336 de 1996 (Estatuto Nacional de Transporte); Resolución 0185 de 2020 del Ministerio de Transporte (agentes de carga internacional); Decreto 1609 de 2002 (transporte de mercancías peligrosas)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Ventanilla Única Empresarial - VUE) para el registro mercantil; Superintendencia de Transporte (SuperTransporte) para la habilitación de agente de carga internacional; DIAN para el Registro Único Tributario
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos Sociales radicado electrónicamente a través del Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) de la Cámara de Comercio, con certificado de homonimia previo
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Sin capital mínimo legal bajo el artículo 5 de la Ley 1258/2008; basta la suscripción y pago de al menos una cuota o acción. Para la habilitación de agente de carga internacional, SuperTransporte exige capacidad financiera y una póliza de cumplimiento y responsabilidad civil, no una cuenta escrow; los aportes en especie admitidos conforme a avalúo pericial y protocolización si incluyen inmuebles.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION - [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. (1) The Sole Shareholder, acting as the General Shareholders' Meeting, approves the total share subscription set out in the incorporation document and acknowledges the payment of the subscribed capital. (2) The corporate bylaws and the private incorporation instrument are adopted and ratified as executed. (3) The registered office is established at the address indicated in the certificate of existence, Bogotá D.C. (4) The President/Legal Representative, the Deputy Representative, the Corporate Secretary, and the Dangerous Goods Compliance Officer are appointed with full powers. (5) The Legal Representative is expressly authorized to file the freight-forwarding and environmental license applications, open bank accounts, and execute the compliance bond. Unanimously approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Homonymy Pre-Validation and Unique Business Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Ventanilla Única Empresarial (www.vue.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUE pre-registration form online with up to three proposed corporate names; pay the homonymy search fee electronically; obtain the 'Certificado de Homonimia' evidencing that the preferred name is available for the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada.
required_dossiers: Formulario Único Empresarial (pre-registro) diligenciado
Cédula de ciudadanía o pasaporte del accionista fundador
Comprobante de pago de la tarifa de homonimia
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is declared confusedly similar, select the next available name from the reservation list within five business days; no additional homonymy fee applies for the second name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Optional Notarization of the Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (solo si se aportan inmuebles o si los accionistas optan por escritura pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the estatutos sociales in accordance with Ley 1258/2008, including share classes, restricted transfer clauses, governance regime, and DG-object clause. Execute the instrument as private document by all shareholders. If real property is contributed, elevate to escritura pública before a Notary and register with the Oficina de Registro de Instrumentos Públicos.
required_dossiers: Estatutos sociales en español
Certificado de homonimia vigente
Documentos de identificación de cada accionista
Avalúo pericial de aportes en especie (si aplica)
Paz y salvo de impuesto predal si se aportan inmuebles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary rejects the deed due to drafting defects, correct the annexed schedules and refile within the notary's revision queue; private instruments may be substituted without formal rejection by a simple recirculation to all signatories.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce Statutory Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio con competencia en el domicilio social (Registro Único Empresarial - RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation document, RUE registration form, and homonymy certificate through the VUE portal; pay the mercantile registration fee plus the 'impuesto de registro' (0.7% of capital value in Bogotá) at the authorized bank network; receive the electronically issued 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal' with the company NIT provisional.
required_dossiers: Documento privado de constituición o escritura pública
Formulario Único Empresarial (RUE) definitivo
Certificado de homonimia
Recibos de pago de derechos de inscripción e impuesto de registro
Aceptación del cargo de representante legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the registry's 'requerimiento de corrección' within three business days via the VUE portal; if the defect is structural, file a reforma de estatutos with unanimous shareholder consent and re-register; the registry cannot refuse incorporation without a written, appealable administrative act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration at DIAN (RUT and NIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales - DIAN (portal Muisca)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online RUT registration form in Muisca; the NIT is assigned automatically; include tax responsibilities for income tax, VAT, and ICA (industry and commerce tax) as applicable; the legal representative must digitally sign the form using the DIAN credential or 'firma electrónica'.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal de la Cámara de Comercio
Estatutos sociales vigentes
Documento de identidad vigente del representante legal
Pre-RUT emitido por el formulario web
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is flagged for inconsistency, rectify the digital form and attend a DIAN assistance appointment; any rejection may be challenged via 'recurso de reposición' before the DIAN sub-direction, or a fresh registration may be filed once the identified error is corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Freight Forwarder and Dangerous Goods License Pre-Application with SuperTransporte
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Transporte - Delegatura de Carga (Sistema de Información SIGETRANS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the electronic application for 'Habilitación como Agente de Carga Internacional' (Resolución 0185/2020), confirming the DG specialization under Decreto 1609/2002; attach the compliance bond (póliza de cumplimiento) in favor of SuperTransporte, demonstrate technical capacity and install the DG handling protocol; await the resolucion de habilitación.
required_dossiers: Formulario de inscripción de agente de carga internacional
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT definitivo con actividad 5229
Póliza de cumplimiento y responsabilidad civil (valor mínimo fijado por SuperTransporte)
Manual de manejo de mercancías peligrosas (clases 2-9 ADR/IMDG/IATA)
Declaración de capacidad financiera y patrimonio neto
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is declared incomplete, complete the file within ten business days; if it is rejected on merits, interpose the 'recurso de reposición' within five days, or resubmit once the underlying operational deficiencies (e.g., bond validity, DG protocol) are cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank duly supervised by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the corporate kit to the bank's business division, complete the AML/KYC onboarding and beneficial ownership registry (Registro de Beneficiario Final), execute the signature authorizations, and deposit the paid-in subscribed capital; obtain the bank references required for documentary credit and Swift wire operations.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (vigencia no mayor a 30 días)
RUT y NIT de la sociedad
Documento de identidad del representante legal y de los beneficiarios finales
Acta de junta directiva y resolución de apertura de cuenta
Referencias comerciales y bancarias de los accionistas
Licencia de habilitación o constancia de trámite ante SuperTransporte
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the KYC compliance unit issues enhanced due diligence requests, deliver the requested ownership charts and source-of-funds declarations; if the account is denied, escalate to the bank's compliance ombudsman and concurrently approach an alternative tier-one bank with the same dossier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Transporte (habilitación de agente de carga) con vista técnicа del Ministerio de Transporte; Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) y Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) para la infraestructura logística
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Habilitación Nacional e Internacional como 'Agente de Carga Internacional' bajo Resolución 0185 de 2020, con certificado adicional de aptitud para el manejo de mercancías peligrosas según Decreto 1609 de 2002 y NTC 1692

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) y Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) competente por la ubicación del patio de contenedores o depósito logístico
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría 2 - Registro Ambiental con Plan de Gestión del Riesgo y Plan de Contingencia para el manejo de sustancias químicas; no se exige Estudio de Impacto Ambiental completo salvo construcción de nueva infraestructura de almacenamiento en zona sensible o cercana a cuerpos de agua, caso en el cual se requiere licencia ambiental global.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Vertimientos industriales conforme Resolución 0631 de 2015: pH 6.0-9.0, DQO máx 200 mg/L, SST máx 50 mg/L, y prohibición de descarga de sustancias peligrosas sin tratamiento; emisiones de COV según Resolución 909 de 2008 con límite típico de 60 mg/m³ en fuentes fijas; gestión integral de residuos peligrosos bajo Decreto 4741 de 2005 con obligación de manifiesto y generador registrado ante la CAR, y límites de PM2.5 de 50 µg/m³ (24h) conforme Resolución 2254 de 2017.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Seguridad Humana contra Incendios expedido por el Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de la jurisdicción (inspección anual de instalaciones eléctricas, hidrantes, extintores y plan de evacuación); Certificado de uso del suelo compatible con transporte/logística de carga emitido por la Curaduría Urbana o alcaldía local; inspección técnica estructural de bodegas y racks firmada por ingeniero civil conforme NSR-10; registro del Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) y Comité COPASST ante la ARL; autorización sanitaria de manejo de residuos peligrosos expedida por la Secretaría Distrital de Salud o la autoridad ambiental regional.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Colombia's National Tax and Customs Authority; primary portals: www.dian.gov.co, MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado), and VUCE (Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior) for customs and export-related filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The statutory tax identification number is the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). A foreign-owned S.A.S. must complete RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration through DIAN's MUISCA e-portal (e-RUT) using the legal representative's certified digital signature, or in person at a DIAN office presenting Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) certified incorporation documents. Non-resident shareholders require no local presence, but the S.A.S. must maintain a Colombian-domiciled legal representative, register the ISIC 5229/dangerous-goods forwarding activity in the RUT, update the RUT upon any change in address, legal form, or tax regime, and appoint a licensed customs broker (SAI - Sociedad de Intermediación Aduanera) for customs and DG forwarding operations. The RUT serves simultaneously as the registry for income tax, VAT, withholding obligations, and foreign-exchange reporting duties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — An S.A.S. is an autonomous legal entity taxed at entity level on worldwide income under the Estatuto Tributario at the standard 35% corporate income tax rate; no pass-through, fiscal-transparency, or check-the-box classification exists in Colombian law. Dividends distributed to foreign shareholders remain subject to shareholder-level withholding taxation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election. The only available statutory elections are: (1) the optional Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for entities with prior-year gross income not exceeding 105,000 UVT (approximately COP 4,941,825,000 at the 2024 UVT of COP 47,065), which replaces income tax, VAT, and industry-and-commerce tax with a single composite payment; (2) the consolidated income-tax filing election for qualifying economic groups (matriz and subordinadas) under Act 2010/2019; and (3) the annual inflation-adjustment election. None of these alter the fundamental entity-level taxation of the S.A.S.; SIMPLE is typically unattractive for a licensed, high-risk DG forwarding entity with substantial insured customs-brokerage revenue, so the default common regime applies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombian value-added tax governed by Estatuto Tributario (E.T.) arts. 420–541 and Decree 1625/2016 (Decreto Único Reglamentario); a national destination-principle consumption tax administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general registration threshold applies: any person or entity performing taxable supplies in Colombia must obtain the RUT/NIT and register as a VAT-responsible party regardless of revenue volume. The only monetary threshold conditions voluntary entry into the SIMPLE regime (prior-year gross income ≤ 105,000 UVT, approximately COP 4,941,825,000 at 2024 UVT); the former simplified VAT regime for small taxpayers was abolished by Act 1819/2016, so this S.A.S. operates under the common VAT regime in all cases.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta — FEV) is in force for all taxpayers under Resolution DIAN 000165/2023. Invoices must be generated through DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free e-invoicing channel, digitally signed with a DIAN-validated electronic certificate, and transmitted to DIAN in near real time for fiscal clearance; DIAN responds with a unique validation code (CUFE or QR CUDE) without which the invoice has no fiscal legal effect. Export invoices (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) are transmitted under the same regime. Failure to issue, or issuing irregular, invoices triggers fines under E.T. art. 652 (up to 1% of prior-year gross income for systematic non-issuance, plus per-invoice penalties) and can entail temporary closure of the establishment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Tangible goods physically exported from Colombia are excluded from IVA under E.T. art. 481, and input VAT borne in producing or handling those goods generates a refundable VAT balance. Services qualify for zero-rating as export of services under E.T. art. 481 num. 8 and Decree 1625/2016 arts. 1.6.1.12.25–1.6.1.12.55 only upon cumulative satisfaction of: (i) the recipient being a foreign person or entity without Colombian domicile or a Colombian permanent establishment; (ii) the service being actually used or commercially exploited abroad; (iii) the service not being re-invoiced by the foreign recipient to a Colombian-domiciled party; and (iv) compliance with the foreign-exchange channelization regime. For this DG forwarding S.A.S., zero-rating applies to freight-forwarding and dangerous-goods logistics services rendered to foreign principals (overseas NVOCCs, offshore cargo owners) with foreign use; services sold to Colombian-domiciled exporters solely to facilitate their shipments are domestically taxable at 19%. International carriage of cargo by air or sea commencing in Colombia also qualifies for the zero-rated export-services basket when the same conditions are met.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX) filed through VUCE/MUISCA and validated by DIAN customs systems at the exit customs office
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (AWB) issued to the exporter/shipper evidencing the physical export movement
Electronic Export Invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) bearing the DIAN-generated CUFE and explicitly evidencing the zero-rated supply
Cargo Manifest (Manifiesto de Carga) endorsed by customs at the seaport or airport of departure

Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas — the foreign-exchange declaration for exports (Formulario No. 1) issued by the authorized exchange-market intermediary, proving timely repatriation and channelization of export proceeds

Dangerous-goods compliance file: IMDG/IMO, IATA-DGR or ICAO-TI DG declaration, competent-authority permits for regulated hazardous chemicals (Ministry of Mines, Ministry of Health, IDEAM, or DIMAR as applicable), and the DG packing/container-vehicle certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-validates the DEX, CUFE-verified export invoices, customs exit records, and Banco de la República foreign-exchange settlement data before any VAT refund is released. Suspected zero-rating abuse triggers: (a) a material reassessment reinstating 19% IVA on the proceeds plus moratory interest (E.T. art. 634); (b) a 10% penalty where the refund was improperly granted (E.T. art. 670); (c) an inexactness penalty of 100% of the over-refunded amount, increased to 200% when fraudulent documents or simulated transactions are shown (E.T. art. 648); (d) exchange-regime fines under Resolución 8/2000 where export proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day deadline (extensions to a maximum of 12 months may be authorized), ranging up to 200% of the un-channelized amount; and (e) criminal tax fraud under E.T. art. 671, punishable by 48–108 months of imprisonment, where the improper refund exceeds 100 SMLMV (approximately COP 142,350,000 at the 2025 minimum wage). DIAN's assessment period is extended to 10 years in fraud cases under E.T. art. 714, making retrospective clawbacks of fraudulently obtained export zero-rating refunds highly probable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central bank), acting through its Junta Directiva and the Comisión de Cambios (Foreign Exchange Commission), with technical administration by the Departamento de Cambios Internacionales. The applicable framework comprises Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Resolution 8 of 2000 of the Junta Directiva, Decree 1951 of 2020, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. Authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (intermediarios del mercado cambiario) are supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), while customs-linked flows and export/import documentation are overseen by DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a unified managed-float foreign-exchange market with no dual or tiered rate. The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account operations: cross-border freight-forwarding service revenue for the CO_SAS DG entity must be channeled through an authorized exchange intermediary and reported via the Declaración de Cambio, but no prior authorizations or quantitative limits apply. Capital-account transactions, specifically foreign-direct-investment capital contributions into the S.A.S., are freely permitted but must be channeled through the Mercado Cambiario and registered with Banco de la República under the foreign-investment registration rules (Formulario No. 2 - Inversiones Internacionales). Profit remittance is legally available once the foreign investment has been properly registered and after DIAN withholding taxes on dividends have been settled; the practical hurdle is documentation integrity, because the bank and the Central Bank require a complete underlying file (contract, commercial invoice, airway bill or bill of lading, DG declaration, insurance certificate, and proof of payment) before the Declaración de Cambio is accepted. Misclassification or incomplete documentation can result in rejected filings, frozen funds, administrative fines, and loss of tax deductibility for the underlying costs.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia imposes a channeling and repatriation obligation rather than a forced conversion or surrender obligation. For export of goods, proceeds must be received in the Mercado Cambiario within six (6) months from the date of the export customs declaration (DEX), with certain extensions available under Decree 1951 of 2020. For export of services, including cross-border freight-forwarding fees of the CO_SAS, the statutory channeling term is six (6) months following the accrual or receipt date of the service compensation, as evidenced by the contractual terms. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0%, meaning the exporter may elect to keep foreign currency in a foreign-currency account with an authorized local bank (cuenta en moneda extranjera), sell it on the spot market, or, if holding funds abroad, use a previously authorized compensation account (cuenta de compensación). All inflows must be declared on the applicable Declaración de Cambio form, and the underlying evidence must be retained for the statutory file period of five (5) years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente Empresarial) with parallel USD foreign-currency sub-account and dedicated FX settlement module for channeling declarations
Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) combined with trade-finance facilities, documentary import/export letters of credit, and capital-inflow tracking sub-ledger
Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) with USD account facility and OTC FX hedging line for forwards and swaps
Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) with cross-border cash-pooling capability via the BBVA international network
Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) with USD collections account for multi-jurisdiction freight invoice settlement
Operational Corporate Account (Cuenta Corriente) with trade-finance and discounting lines tied to the Itaú regional network

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low (legally constrained) with a narrow operational edge case. Offshore electronic-money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury, and Currencycloud are not licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and do not qualify as intermediaries del mercado cambiario; therefore, they cannot satisfy Colombia's mandatory channeling and Declaración de Cambio obligations for freight service revenue or for outbound payments related to imports of services. Using an offshore EMI as the primary treasury rail exposes the CO_SAS DG forwarding entity to foreign-exchange control fines, weakens the auditable FX evidence trail, and may trigger loss of cost deductibility for DIAN purposes. The only permissible supplementary use is the collection of immaterial, low-ticket invoices from counterparties in jurisdictions without a Colombian banking relationship, followed by an immediate onward SWIFT transfer into the Colombian authorized-bank account so that the actual FX channeling obligation is still executed legally.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for the legal representative (representante legal) and, where required, the AML compliance officer (oficial de cumplimiento) during the bank account opening interview for a high-risk dangerous-goods forwarder. Colombian tier-1 banks apply the SAGRILAFT customer-due-diligence framework of the Circular Básica Jurídica, which for high-risk clients requires in-person identity verification, behavioral interview, and inspection of corporate documentation at the branch. Fully remote opening is not accepted for the DG forwarding segment. Non-resident shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners may satisfy their interview obligation through a notarized and apostilled power of attorney granted to a Colombian resident administrator, supplemented by a verified video interview; foreign-country notarizations must be legalized by consular or apostille process and be accompanied by sworn source-of-funds statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: S.A.S. structures with nominee shareholders, multi-layer foreign holding companies, or UBO concentrations above the 5% reporting threshold
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO declaration form identifying every individual holding directly or indirectly more than 5% of capital or control; up-to-date share registry (libro de registro de acciones); notarized estatutos and constitutional documents; apostilled identity documents and proof of address for non-resident shareholders; sworn affidavit on source of wealth and source of funds; certified financial statements or opening balance sheet; negative PEP/sanctions screening report for each UBO; and a signed commitment to update the UBO register within the statutory term.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dangerous-goods statutory-license gap: bank flags that the entity engages in DG/Hazmat transport forwarding without evidence of the special operating permits or that the corporate purpose is not aligned with the licensed activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid statutory operating authorization for international freight forwarding and dangerous-cargo handling under the Ministerio de Transporte regime, including the habilitación or registro as an international cargo agency; the DIAN customs registry (Registro Nacional de Agencias de Aduanas or auxiliary customs operator status where applicable); the hazardous-goods transport certificate covering the specific UN classes; environmental or origin permits for regulated chemicals, where required; third-party liability and cargo insurance policies listing the CO_SAS as insured; and a written DG compliance manual with designated transport safety personnel and emergency-response protocols.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and trade-control exposure of the counterparty network: carriers, consignors, consignees, intermediate ports, or container operators appearing on OFAC, EU, UN, or national denial lists or in high-risk transit jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented sanctions screening policy and automated daily denied-party-list screening results covering all counterparties, beneficial owners of counterparties, vessels, aircraft, ports, and banks; letter of engagement with each counterparty requiring red-flag disclosure; jurisdiction-risk assessment matrix and route-level clearance memos; management attestation on OFAC/EU/UN compliance; and contractual clauses prohibiting dealings with sanctioned parties and requiring compliance-flow-down to subcontractors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds insufficiency for inbound capital injection: newly formed S.A.S. entity with foreign capital that cannot prove the origin and lawful derivation of shareholder funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Protocolized shareholders' minutes approving the capital contribution; bank reference letter from the remitting bank; SWIFT MT103 transfer instruction with the explicit purpose narrative of foreign direct investment; three months of bank statements of the contributing shareholder; certified tax returns or financial statements of the shareholder from the source jurisdiction; sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; and an auditor or legal counsel opinion confirming the transaction is consistent with the corporate purpose and Colombian exchange-control rules.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for the non-resident shareholder capital injection: (i) remitting party executes SWIFT MT103 to the authorized Colombian intermediary bank where the CO_SAS has its operational account, using the beneficiary name exactly matching the NIT and RUT records and the SWIFT narrative 'Aporte de capital social a CO_SAS - Inversión Extranjera Directa / Foreign Direct Investment'; (ii) the intermediary bank applies the applicable purpose concept under Circular DCIN-83, credits the capital account, and files the Declaración de Cambio Formulario No. 2 with Banco de la República, thereby creating the formal foreign-investment registration; to accelerate compliance the company should pre-register the investment in the Banco de la República electronic platform before funds arrive; (iii) the entity must deliver the full AML/KYC pack (protocolized minutes, updated RUT, Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation, UBO declaration, source-of-funds file) within the bank's verification window; if the compliance file is deficient, the bank will classify the inflow as suspect and effectively hold the funds pending compliance-officer review; (iv) the registration filing must be completed within the term established by Decree 1951 of 2020, generally twelve months from channeling, to avoid late-registration fines and any impediment to future profit repatriation; after registration, the company updates the local capital records at the Cámara de Comercio.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails are (a) SWIFT MT103/MT202 beneficiary transfers for routine outbound settlements to overseas carriers, multimodal transport operators, marine terminal operators, drayage providers, insurance brokers, and subcontractors; (b) commercial documentary letters of credit issued under UCP 600 (sight or deferred payment) to acquire specialized DG-capital assets such as IMO-certified containers, tank-containers, hazmat handling equipment, and tractor units, and for high-value verifiable single transactions; and (c) the mandatory Colombian exchange-market channeling of all service import payments via the authorized intermediary bank with the corresponding Declaración de Cambio (service-payment form) grounded on the invoice, contract, and, for freight-related costs, the underlying transport document. Because the DG forwarding model is sanctions-sensitive, the treasury function must pre-validate every foreign beneficiary against OFAC/EU/UN denial lists before initiating a wire and must retain the substantiating export/import documentation in the Declaración de Cambio file for the five-year statutory retention period.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/COP forward contracts executed through authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediaries, requiring an identifiable underlying channelable exposure and prohibiting purely speculative positioning
Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP) for medium-term working-capital and trade-finance facilities with documented matching cash flows
Non-deliverable forwards (USD/COP NDFs), cash-settled, permitted as hedging instruments only when the CO_SAS can evidence committed future freight receivables or payables in foreign currency
OTC FX option structures (collars, knock-in, knock-out) referencing the USD/COP rate, arranged with a domestic authorized bank and subject to the same underlying-exposure documentation

Natural structural hedging via foreign-currency accounts (cuentas en moneda extranjera) and matching of freight invoices and supplier bills in USD or EUR, minimizing derivative dependence for routine treasury operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal / Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 (Article 33, Código de Comercio)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee calculated on the renewal tariff, risk of temporary registry suspension, and administrative cancellation after repeated non-renewal; formal strike-off by the Chamber of Commerce possible after three consecutive years without renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the calendar window set by DIAN based on the NIT last digit, normally between April and August of the following fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month or fraction thereof, capped at 100% of the tax; plus inflation adjustment, default interest, and monetary fines up to 1,900 UVT; no administrative strike-off, but tax debt can lead to asset embargo.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización del Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month following the anniversary of the initial UBO registration, or immediately upon any change in beneficial ownership; DIAN publishes the specific annual calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties for non-reporting, inaccurate reporting, or late update; assessments per UVT per affected fiscal period, plus the risk of administrative closure or escalating fines for high-risk logistics operators.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros e Informe de Gestión (Statutory Financial Statements and Management Report filed with the Commercial Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (alongside registre renewal) / Superintendencia de Sociedades if subject to surveillance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 each year, unless a different date is established by the Superintendencia for supervised entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers the same registry renewal sanctions and can be treated as a separate violation by the Superintendencia; monetary fines up to 200 UVT for formal non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A sworn statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory if the company exceeds the thresholds under Colombian law: gross revenues above 3,000 UVT, total assets above 5,000 UVT, or more than 30 employees; otherwise the shareholders may opt for a less formal independent review.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF Plenas) for Group 1, NIIF PYMES for Group 2, or NIIF para Microempresas for Group 3, under DUR 2420 de 2015 and subsequent amendments.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must independently report all direct and indirect ultimate beneficial owners holding 5% or more, voting rights, or effective control to DIAN through the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales; the report must be updated annually on the registration anniversary and within one month of any share transfer or control change. Failure to update disallows corporate actions and triggers automatic tax penalties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Beneficiarios Finales (Certified Filing Confirmation)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general sectoral tax holidays for SAS entities. Targeted reliefs may reduce effective burden: (i) 50% current-year deduction for investments in productive fixed assets for taxable years 2023-2027 under Law 2277/2022, subject to employment preservation; (ii) 25% tax credit for qualifying R&D investment; (iii) exemption from VAT on certain imported capital equipment used in maritime and air logistics. A DG freight forwarder may also claim ordinary deductions for DG-compliant facility upgrades and hazmat insurance, but no statutory zero-rate regime applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 - Declaración de Renta y Complementario, submitted electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) using the taxpayer's electronic signature (firma electrónica).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. The fiscal period for a Colombian S.A.S. is the calendar year. A newly incorporated SAS must file for the short period from incorporation date to December 31. Quarterly payments to DIAN are provisional instalments on account of the annual corporate income tax, not separate corporate returns.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The statutory ceiling is six months after the fiscal year-end. DIAN publishes an annual filing calendar by taxpayer NIT ending digit; for a 31 December fiscal year this calendar normally runs from April 10 through June 24 of the following year. Large taxpayers are assigned earlier dates in April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues from dangerous-goods freight forwarding, international shipping and logistics, charter fees, consolidation services, and ancillary warehousing or customs-related services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Colombian-resident SAS, all worldwide income is reportable unless specifically excluded by treaty or Colombian law; foreign-source income attributable to the SAS must be included. A non-resident without a permanent establishment in Colombia must not file Form 110, and is instead taxed via withholding where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs and expenses: certified hazmat handling costs, charter and vessel/aircraft hire, freight interchange, insurance, customs bonds, staffing, depreciation, and DG compliance expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If Form 110 is filed for a Colombian PE of a foreign enterprise, expenses are deductible only to the extent they are effectively connected and properly allocated to the Colombian PE. Intercompany charges from a foreign parent must satisfy the arm's-length principle and Colombian transfer-pricing documentation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income after deducting costs and operating expenses, before adjusting for statutory tax-loss compensation and other subtractions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only properly documented amounts. Tax losses may be carried forward and offset in this line for up to 12 taxable years, subject to the rules of Article 147 E.T. and DIAN inflationary adjustment requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income after all exclusions, deductions, exemptions, and prior-year loss compensation. The 35% corporate rate is applied to this base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For treaty purposes, income genuinely attributable to a Colombian PE of the foreign shareholder remains taxable in Colombia; treaty-based reductions for royalties or interest must be evidenced before applying the treaty line reductions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income tax resulting from applying the statutory rate or treaty-modified rate to Renglon 69, before tax credits and advance payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate any foreign tax credit claimed on foreign-source income and any withholding tax already paid. Dividend withholding at 10% is not computed on this line; it is an additional non-resident shareholder liability triggered upon distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers the extemporaneity sanction under Article 641 E.T.: 5% of the income tax due per month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 100% of tax due. If no tax is due, the penalty is 0.5% of gross income (or 1% of net equity when income is zero), subject to a minimum of 10 UVT per fiscal year. Default interest runs from the original deadline, and false declarations expose the company to an inaccuracy penalty of 100% of the omitted tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividend distributions made to non-resident legal entities or foreign resident individuals out of profits that have already been taxed at the entity level. Colombian-resident corporate shareholders are generally exempt from dividend withholding. The total blended tax burden on distributed Colombian-source profits to a non-resident shareholder is approximately 41.5% (35% corporate + 10% dividend withholding).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced rate under a Colombia DTA, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a current Certificate of Fiscal Residence from its home tax authority and deliver it to the Colombian withholding agent before the distribution date. The withholding agent reviews the certificate and, where needed, submits a residence certificate and a treaty claim form to DIAN for administrative validation. If the claim is applied at source, the reduced DTA rate is used; otherwise the excess withholding must be refunded through the DIAN 'solicitud de devolución' procedure after the fiscal year-end. Colombia requires that no Colombian PE be present for dividend-treaty relief to apply, and the dividend must be paid to the beneficial owner.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory WHT on interest paid to non-residents is generally 15%, although DTA-protected structures may reduce it to between 5% and 10%. Royalties paid to non-residents are subject to domestic WHT of 20% (increased by DIAN to 33% for certain transfers of know-how or intangible exploitation when recharacterized as earnings from personal services or technical assistance). DTA rates for royalties generally range from 5% to 10%, subject to source-country taxing rights. Technical service fees paid abroad may also be recharacterized as royalties when the payer receives the right to use an intellectual asset; the session must be documented separately.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File documentation under Articles 260-1 and 260-5 E.T. is triggered when the Colombian taxpayer's gross income or net assets exceed 100,000 UVT (COP 4,706,500,000 for tax year 2024, where UVT = COP 47,065), or when intercompany operations with foreign related parties exceed 10,000 UVT. Multinational groups with consolidated revenue above 600,000 UVT (COP 28,239,000,000) must also prepare a Master File. Country-by-Country notification applies where group revenue exceeds EUR 750 million. For FY2023 and FY2024 these amounts are annually indexed by DIAN.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not maintain a separate Economic Substance Regulations regime like Caribbean or Gulf jurisdictions, but the law contains powerful substance-over-form and anti-avoidance doctrines. Article 36 of Law 1258 of 2008 allows courts and DIAN to 'pierce the veil' of an S.A.S. when it is used as a mere instrumentality for tax evasion or shareholder fraud. DIAN may also disregard transactions lacking commercial rationality under the general anti-evasion clause introduced by Law 1819 of 2016. A DG freight-forwarding SAS must maintain actual personnel, office facilities, transport contracts, DG permits, and documentary proof of operational decision-making in Colombia; a nominal office recording invoices for an offshore principal will be recharacterized as shell-company profit shifting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilfully understating gross freight income, inflating costs, issuing false or simulated DG transport invoices, or omitting foreign-source cargo handling revenue from Form 110 with the intent to reduce the taxable base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines and imprisonment under Article 434 Bis of the Colombian Criminal Code (Law 599/2000): 48 to 108 months imprisonment when evasion exceeds 250 current monthly legal minimum wages. DIAN also imposes a 100% inaccuracy penalty on the omitted tax amount, plus default interest, and may order asset embargoes to secure the tax obligation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or direct the fraudulent declaration become jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt plus penalties. Travel bans, precautionary detention, and prohibition from commercial activity may be imposed during the criminal investigation. Civil restitution and disqualification from serving as director of regulated transport or logistics entities also apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SAS as a letterbox entity with no permanent physical presence, no operational staff, no DG transportation infrastructure, and no real functions, structured solely to classify Colombian-source freight profits as non-resident income or to strip revenue through artificial management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Veil-piercing under Article 36 of Law 1258 of 2008, with DIAN disregarding the entity's separate existence and reallocating income to the beneficial shareholder or parent. In addition, the taxpayer faces the 100% inaccuracy penalty, default interest, and forced liquidation of the shell for failing to obtain and keep the required dangerous-goods transport license. Regulatory authorities may impose fines equivalent to 10,000 current legal monthly minimum wages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and directors may be personally liable for the entire tax deficiency, unpaid social security, and creditor claims. A court may order asset forfeiture, exit bans, and direct restitution to the treasury. Criminal prosecution for money laundering is possible when the shell is used to obscure charges for illegal hazmat shipments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intercompany DG freight services with a foreign related party at a deliberately low rate (Colombian loss) while value is earned abroad, failing to file the mandatory Form 220, or preparing no Local File when the 100,000 UVT threshold is met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN recharacterization of the non-arm's-length transaction, upward adjustment of Colombian taxable income, application of the 100% inaccuracy penalty on the additional tax assessed, plus default interest. Failure to present transfer-pricing documentation or to file the mandatory annex triggers autonomous fines of up to 20,000 UVT or 1% of the related-party transaction value, whichever is lower.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve a sham intercompany fee schedule are jointly liable for the resulting tax deficiency and penalties. For wilful manipulation, criminal sanctions for evasion or conspiracy apply. The commercial registry may also be suspended after an administrative declaration of non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: High-Risk Hazmat License and AML Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Handling dangerous goods and DG freight forwarding without the valid operating licence from the Ministry of Transport and DIAN, or failing to implement the mandatory AML/KYC program in a sector classified as high-risk for money laundering and terrorist financing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate suspension or cancellation of the DG transport authorization, fines of up to COP 1,900,000,000 under transport regulations, and seizure of the involved cargo or vessels. Criminal liability arises under Articles 323 and 340 of the Criminal Code for financing illicit transport of hazardous substances, with sentences from 8 to 20 years and asset-expense seizure under Law 1708 of 2014.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal indictment, travel bans, prolonged pretrial detention, and civil liability to third parties damaged by a DG incident or AML breach. International mutual legal assistance may trigger Interpol red notices. In addition, directors become jointly liable for fines imposed on the SAS when they knowingly operated without authorization.
